channelTitle: Long day at the desk? Grandma June's neck trick takes 2 minutes
hook: Before massage tools and heating wraps, this is all grandmothers really needed.
remedy: Wrapping a warm, damp towel around the neck and shoulders is an old, simple home remedy for easing tension after a long day of stress or hunching over a desk.
steps: Soak a hand towel in warm water and wring it out well
Fold it and drape it around the back of your neck and shoulders
Sit back and relax for ten to fifteen minutes while it cools naturally
caution: Make sure the towel isn't too hot before applying it, especially on sensitive skin.
cta: Does a warm towel help your tension too, or do you have a different unwind trick? Tell Grandma June below.
